name: Naturo Indiabull Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2016, Naturo Indiabull Ltd manufactures agriculture and industrial items and also provides transportation logistics services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
NAIL, previously trading in healthcare and FMCG products, now manufactures fertilizers, chemicals, and industrial items. It also offers logistics services for transporting goods and people by land, sea, and air.
